items.source: The mapped value can either be a corresponding SessionFactory instance or a data source name String (to be resolved via a setSessionFactoryLookup(SessionFactoryLookup)).
items.translation: 映射值可以是相应的SessionFactory实例，或者是一个数据源名称字符串（将通过setSessionFactoryLookup(SessionFactoryLookup)进行解析）。

items.source: Resolve the given lookup key object, as specified in the setTargetSessionFactories(Map) map, into the actual lookup key to be used for matching with the current lookup key.
items.translation: 解析给定的查找键对象，该对象由setTargetSessionFactories(Map) 地图中指定，将其转换为用于与当前查找键进行匹配的实际查找键。

items.source: Specify whether to apply a lenient fallback to the default SessionFactory if no specific SessionFactory could be found for the current lookup key.
items.translation: 指定是否在没有为当前查找键找到特定的 SessionFactory 时，对默认 SessionFactory 应用宽松的降级策略。

items.source: Set the SessionFactoryLookup implementation to use for resolving session factory name Strings in the setTargetSessionFactories(Map) map.
items.translation: 将 SessionFactoryLookup 的实现设置为用于解析 setTargetSessionFactories(Map) 映射中的会话工厂名称字符串。

items.source: Attempts to establish a CqlSession with the connection infrastructure that this SessionFactory object represents.
items.translation: 尝试使用此SessionFactory对象所代表的连接基础设施建立CqlSession。

items.source: Resolve the specified sessionFactory object into a SessionFactory instance.
items.translation: 将指定的sessionFactory对象解析为SessionFactory实例。

items.source: Specify the default target SessionFactory, if any.
items.translation: 指定默认目标（如果有）SessionFactory。

items.source: Specify the map of target session factories, with the lookup key as key.
items.translation: 指定目标会话工厂的映射，其中查找键为 key。

items.source: This SessionFactory will be used as target if none of the keyed setTargetSessionFactories(Map) match the determineCurrentLookupKey() current lookup key.
items.translation: 如果没有任何带键的setTargetSessionFactories(Map)与determineCurrentLookupKey()的当前查找键匹配，则将使用此SessionFactory作为目标。

items.source: The key can be of arbitrary type; this class implements the generic lookup process only. The concrete key representation will be handled by resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object) and determineCurrentLookupKey().
items.translation: 键可以是任意类型；该类仅实现通用的查找过程。具体的键表示将由 resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object) 和 determineCurrentLookupKey() 处理。

items.source: Default is true, accepting lookup keys without a corresponding entry in the target SessionFactory map - simply falling back to the default SessionFactory in that case.
items.translation: 默认为 true，接受在目标SessionFactory映射中找不到对应条目的查找键——在这种情况下，直接回退到默认的SessionFactory。

items.source: Switch this flag to false if you would prefer the fallback to only apply if the lookup key was null. Lookup keys without a SessionFactory entry will then lead to an IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 如果希望仅在查找键为 null 时才应用回退，请将此标志切换为 false。若查找键中缺少 SessionFactory 条目，则会导致 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Default is a MapSessionFactoryLookup, allowing a string keyed map of session factories.
items.translation: 默认值为一个MapSessionFactoryLookup，它允许使用字符串键来映射session factories。

items.source: The default implementation handles SessionFactory instances and session factory names (to be resolved via a setSessionFactoryLookup(SessionFactoryLookup)).
items.translation: 默认实现处理 SessionFactory 实例和会话工厂名称（通过 setSessionFactoryLookup(SessionFactoryLookup) 解析）。

items.source: The default implementation simply returns the given key as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现直接返回给定的键。

items.source: Allows for arbitrary keys.
items.translation: 支持任意键。

items.source: Retrieve the current target SessionFactory. Determines the current lookup key, performs a lookup in the setTargetSessionFactories(Map) map, falls back to the specified default target SessionFactory if necessary.
items.translation: 获取当前的目标 SessionFactory。确定 当前查找键，在 setTargetSessionFactories(Map) 映射中进行查找，必要时回退到指定的 默认目标 SessionFactory。

items.source: Abstract SessionFactory implementation that routes getSession() calls to one of various target factories based on a lookup key. The latter is usually (but not necessarily) determined through some thread-bound transaction context.
items.translation: 实现了 SessionFactory 接口，该实现会根据查找键将 getSession() 调用路由到多个目标 factories 之一。后者通常（但不一定）通过线程绑定的事务上下文确定。

items.translation: 当前查找键。返回的键必须与存储的查找键类型匹配。
